<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex64082023-09-261" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (22b1-22b2)"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5131">mtha' bral dbu' ma'i rnam bzhag gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me</rs> 'dis | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7024"><expan>chos smra</expan> ba'i <expan>gshes bsnyen</expan> shes ldan <expan>gzu bor</expan> gnas pa'i don gnyer ba <expan>bstan 'dzin</expan></rs> zhes pas nan <choice><sic>gyi</sic><corr>gyis</corr></choice> bskul ba la <expan>brten nas</expan> | sde snod 3 dang <lb n="22b2"/> rgyud sde <expan>bzhi</expan> 4 | dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la blo'i snang ba cung zad thob pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4674">rat+na kir+ti</rs> zhes bya bas rang lo brgyad bcu lon pa me mo <expan>lugs gi</expan> lo <expan>smin drug</expan> zla ba'i dkar phyogs<note type="editorial">Kārttika śukla pakṣa</note> la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5699">dpal glang ri thang gi gtsug lag khang</rs> du sbyar ba <expan>rdzogs so</expan> || shu b+haM ||</seg></TEI>
